title: 004. Longest Consecutive Sequence
prompt: Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. You must write an algorithm that runs in `O(N)` time.
invariant: (x - 1) not in num_set  →  x is the start of a consecutive chain

hints.title: Mental Model & Intuition
hints.content: Sorting takes `O(N log N)`. Instead, throw all numbers into a Hash Set for `O(1)` lookup, and only start counting a chain from its true 'head' (a number `x` whose left neighbor `x - 1` is NOT in the set).

hints.title: Pattern Identification
hints.content: Hash Set + Sequence-Head Detection (`if (x - 1) not in num_set:`).

hints.title: Algorithmic Invariant
hints.content: Because the inner `while (x + length) in num_set:` loop ONLY runs for sequence heads, each element in the set is visited at most twice across the entire algorithm—guaranteeing strict `O(N)` time.

hints.title: Edge Cases & Scaffolding
hints.content: Check empty array `[]` (returns `0`), single element `[10]` (returns `1`), and arrays with duplicates `[0, 1, 1, 2]` (Hash Set deduplicates automatically).
